attribute	vec3 attr_pos;
attribute	vec3 attr_nrm;
attribute	vec4 attr_col;
attribute	vec2 attr_tex1;
attribute	vec4 attr_idx;
attribute	vec4 attr_wei;
varying		vec3 vary_pos;
varying		vec2 vary_tex1;
varying		vec3 vary_nrm;
varying		vec4 vary_col;
uniform		mat4 uni_mat_m;
uniform		mat4 uni_mat_v;
uniform		mat4 uni_mat_p;
uniform		mat4 uni_mat_uv1;
uniform		vec4 uni_mat_ary[42*3];
void main()
	vary_col = attr_col;
	vary_tex1 = (uni_mat_uv1 * vec4(attr_tex1, 0.0, 1.0)).xy;
	vary_tex1.y = -vary_tex1.y + 1.0;
	int index = int(attr_idx.x) * 3;
	mat4 mat;
	mat[0]  = uni_mat_ary[index + 0] * attr_wei.x; 
	mat[1]  = uni_mat_ary[index + 1] * attr_wei.x;
	mat[2]  = uni_mat_ary[index + 2] * attr_wei.x;
	index = int(attr_idx.y) * 3;
	mat[0] += uni_mat_ary[index + 0] * attr_wei.y;
	mat[1] += uni_mat_ary[index + 1] * attr_wei.y;
	mat[2] += uni_mat_ary[index + 2] * attr_wei.y;
	index = int(attr_idx.z) * 3;
	mat[0] += uni_mat_ary[index + 0] * attr_wei.z;
	mat[1] += uni_mat_ary[index + 1] * attr_wei.z;
	mat[2] += uni_mat_ary[index + 2] * attr_wei.z;
	index = int(attr_idx.w) * 3;
	mat[0] += uni_mat_ary[index + 0] * attr_wei.w;
	mat[1] += uni_mat_ary[index + 1] * attr_wei.w;
	mat[2] += uni_mat_ary[index + 2] * attr_wei.w;
	mat[3] = vec4(0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0);
	vec4 pos = vec4(attr_pos, 1.0) * mat;
	vary_pos = ( pos * uni_mat_m ).xyz;
	vary_nrm = ( ( vec4(attr_nrm, 0.0) * mat ) * uni_mat_m ).xyz;
	gl_Position = pos * uni_mat_p;

precision highp float;
varying vec3 vary_pos;
varying vec2 vary_tex1;
varying vec3 vary_nrm;
varying vec4 vary_col;
uniform sampler2D uni_tex1;
uniform samplerCube uni_tex2;
uniform sampler2D uni_tex3;
uniform sampler2D uni_tex4;
const float _fakeCameraPos = 42.0;
const float _AnimeReflectScale = 0.25;
const float _AnimeReflectAngleOffsetX = 1.0;
const float _AnimeReflectAngleOffsetY = 0.65;
const float _AnimeReflectOffsetX = -0.725;
const float _AnimeReflectOffsetY = 0.0;
const float _AnimeReflectVolume = 0.025;
const float _AnimeReflectWidth = 0.05;
const float _AnimeReflectClampX = 7.0;
const float _AnimeReflectClampY = 14.0;
const float _FresnelPower = 1.0;
const vec3 _Specular0 = vec3(0.156, 0.117, 0.117);
const float _SpecularPower = 4.0;
const vec4 _AmbientColor = vec4(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0);
const float _CameraZ = 42.0;
const vec3 _CameraPos = vec3(0.0, 0.0, _CameraZ);
float v2c(float vecValue)
	return vecValue * 0.5 + 0.5;
vec3 v2c(vec3 vec)
	return vec3( v2c(vec.x), v2c(vec.y), v2c(vec.z) );
vec4 v2c(vec4 vec)
	return vec4( v2c(vec.x), v2c(vec.y), v2c(vec.z), v2c(vec.w) );
float c2v(float colorValue)
	return colorValue * 2.0 - 1.0;
vec3 c2v(vec3 color)
	return vec3( c2v(color.r), c2v(color.g), c2v(color.b) );
vec4 c2v(vec4 color)
	return vec4( c2v(color.r), c2v(color.g), c2v(color.b), c2v(color.a) );
mat3 getWorldToTangent(vec3 N, vec3 p, vec2 uv)
#ifdef GL_OES_standard_derivatives
	vec3 dp1 = dFdx(p);
	vec3 dp2 = dFdy(p);
	vec2 duv1 = dFdx(uv);
	vec2 duv2 = dFdy(uv);
	vec3 dp2perp = cross( dp2, N );
	vec3 dp1perp = cross( N, dp1 );
	vec3 T = normalize(dp2perp * duv1.x + dp1perp * duv2.x);
	vec3 B = normalize(cross(N, T));
	float invmax = inversesqrt( max( dot(T,T), dot(B,B) ) );
	return mat3( T * invmax, B * invmax, N );
#else
    return mat3(0.0);
#endif
void main()
	vec4 texClr = texture2D(uni_tex1, vary_tex1);
	gl_FragColor = texClr;
	vec3 Vn = normalize(_CameraPos - vary_pos);
	vec3 normal = normalize(vary_nrm);
	mat3 worldToTangent = getWorldToTangent(normal, vary_pos-_CameraPos, vec2(vary_tex1.x, 1.0-vary_tex1.y));
	vec3 vCol = vec3( c2v(vary_col.r), c2v(vary_col.g), c2v(vary_col.b) );
	vec3 secondNormal = normalize( ( worldToTangent * vCol ).xyz );
	float rim = clamp( dot(Vn, secondNormal), 0.0, 1.0 );
	vec3 fresnel = texture2D(uni_tex4, vec2(rim, 0.25)).rgb;
	vec3 specular = texture2D(uni_tex4, vec2(rim, 0.75)).rgb;
	vec3 normalFresnel = mix( vec3(0.0), texClr.rgb, fresnel*_FresnelPower );
	vec3 normalSpecular = mix( vec3(0.0), _Specular0.rgb, specular*_SpecularPower );
	gl_FragColor.rgb = clamp( texClr.rgb*(1.0+normalSpecular), 0.0, 1.0 ) + normalFresnel;
	vec3 camVec = _CameraPos - vary_pos;
	vec3 reflectVec = reflect(-camVec, secondNormal);
	vec3 cubeTexColor = textureCube(uni_tex2, reflectVec, 0.0).rgb;
	vec3 fakeCamPos = normalize(_CameraPos) * _fakeCameraPos;
	vec3 fakeCameraVec = fakeCamPos - vary_pos;
	vec2 tmpRef0 = ( -normalize(fakeCameraVec) * worldToTangent ).xy;
	tmpRef0 = tmpRef0 * vec2(_AnimeReflectAngleOffsetX, _AnimeReflectAngleOffsetY);
	tmpRef0 = tmpRef0 + vec2(_AnimeReflectOffsetX, _AnimeReflectOffsetY);
	float ref0 = step( sin( clamp( abs(tmpRef0.x + tmpRef0.y) / _AnimeReflectVolume, _AnimeReflectClampX, _AnimeReflectClampY) ), _AnimeReflectWidth );
	vec3 worldLightVec = normalize( vec3(-1.0, 1.0, 1.0) );
	float ref1 = pow( clamp( dot(worldLightVec, normal), 0.0, 1.0 ), 3.0 );
	vec3 animeRef = mix( vec3(0.0), cubeTexColor, clamp(ref0+ref1, 0.0, 1.0) ) * _AnimeReflectScale;
	vec3 amountSpecular = clamp(cubeTexColor + animeRef, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 refBaseColor = texClr.rgb * (1.0 / (1.0 - amountSpecular.rgb));
	vec3 refFresnelColor;
	refFresnelColor.r = mix( 2.0 * texClr.r * amountSpecular.r, 1.0 - (2.0 * (1.0 - texClr.r) * (1.0 - amountSpecular.r)), step(0.5, amountSpecular.r) );
	refFresnelColor.g = mix(2.0*texClr.g*amountSpecular.g, 1.0-(2.0*(1.0-texClr.g)*(1.0-amountSpecular.g)), step(0.5, amountSpecular.g));
	refFresnelColor.b = mix(2.0*texClr.b*amountSpecular.b, 1.0-(2.0*(1.0-texClr.b)*(1.0-amountSpecular.b)), step(0.5, amountSpecular.b));
	vec3 refColor = mix( mix(texClr.rgb, refFresnelColor, 0.75), clamp(refBaseColor, 0.0, 1.0), clamp(fresnel*_FresnelPower, 0.0, 1.0) );
	refColor = mix( refColor, clamp(refBaseColor, 0.0, 1.0), _Specular0.rgb );
	vec3 speculerMask = texture2D(uni_tex3, vary_tex1).rgb;
	gl_FragColor.rgb = mix( refColor.rgb, gl_FragColor.rgb, speculerMask );
	gl_FragColor.rgb = gl_FragColor.rgb * _AmbientColor.rgb;
	gl_FragColor.a = texClr.a;

function h5ggType(type)
    if($("input:radio[name=numtype]:checked").val()=="unsigned") {
        switch(type) {
            case "I8":
                return "U8";
            case "I16":
                return "U16";
            case "I32":
                return "U32";
            case "I64":
                return "U64";
        }
    }
    
    return type;

function refreshProcList(procs)
    $("#proctable button").remove();
    
    for(var i=0; i<procs.length; i++) {
        var proc = procs[i];
        var btn = $("<button>"+proc.name+"</button>");
        btn.attr("pid", proc.pid);
        btn.click(function()
        {
            if(!h5gg.setTargetProc($(this).attr('pid'))) {
                alert("
                return;
            }
            
            onClickClearResults();
            
            $("#procname").attr('pid', $(this).attr('pid'));
            $("#procname").text($(this).text());
            $("#popup_proclist").hide();
            $("#maskview").hide();
        });
        
        $("#proctable").append(btn);
    }
function refreshLocalSrcipts()
    $("table#localjslist tr").remove();
    
    var jsfiles = h5gg.getLocalScripts();
    setTimeout(function(){
        
        if(jsfiles.length==0) {
            $("table#localjslist tbody").append("<tr><td colspan=2>
Documents
...<br/>
.app
...<br/>
(*.js)
(*.html)
!</td></td>");
        }
        
        $("table#localjslist tbody").append('<tr><td style="border-right-style:none; color:blue">
</td><td style="border-left-style:none;width:45px"><button onclick="h5gg.pickScriptFile(onClickLoadScript)">
</button></td></tr>');
        
        for(var i=0; i<jsfiles.length; i++) {
            var row = '<tr><td style="border-right-style:none;font-weight:bold;color:green">'+jsfiles[i].name+'</td><td style="border-left-style:none;width:45px"><button onclick="onClickLoadScript(\''+jsfiles[i].path+'\')">
</button></td></tr>';
            $("table#localjslist tbody").append(row);
        }
    }, 300);
function onShowLoadScript(show)
    if(show) {
        $("#maskview").show();
        $("#popup_loadscripts").show();
        
        if(typeof h5gg!='undefined') refreshLocalSrcipts();
    } else {
        $("#maskview").hide();
        $("#popup_loadscripts").hide();
    }
function onClickLoadScript(url, type)
    if(!url) return;
    
    if(/^\w+\:/.test(url)==false) url = "file://"+url;
    
    try{
        url = new URL(url);
        url.searchParams.append("_", Math.random());
    }catch(e){
        alert("
URL");
        return;
    }
    
    $("#popup_progress").show();
    $("#maskview_script").show();
    
    if(type=='h5' || (!type&&!/\.js$/.test(url.pathname))) {
        window.location = url.href;
        return;
    }
    
    var script = document.createElement("script");
    script.type = "text/javascript";
    
    script.onload = function () {
      alert("JS
        $("#popup_progress").hide();
        $("#maskview_script").hide();
    };
    
    script.onerror = function () {
        alert("
        $("#popup_progress").hide();
        $("#maskview_script").hide();
    };
    script.src = url.href;
    document.body.appendChild(script);
function showPopView(name, action, type, value)
    $("#maskview").show();
    $("#popup_search_edit").show();
    $("#popup_search_edit").find("B#titleBar").html(name);
    $("#popup_search_edit").find("button#action").html(name);
    
    if(type) {
        $("table#datatype td").each(function(){
            if($(this).text()==type)
                $(this).addClass("selected");
            else
                $(this).removeClass("selected");
        });
    }
    
    if(value) {
        $("input#datavalue").val(value);
    }
    
    $("input#datavalue").focus();
    
    $("#popup_search_edit").find("button#action").unbind("click").click(function(){
        var type = $("table#datatype td.selected").text();
        var value = $("input#datavalue").val();
        
        $("#popup_search_edit").hide();
        $("#popup_progress").show();
        
        setTimeout(function() {
            
            action(type, value);
            
            $("#popup_progress").hide();
            $("#maskview").hide();
        }, 200);
        
    });
    
    $("#popup_search_edit").find("button#cancel").unbind("click").click(function(){
        $("#maskview").hide();
        $("#popup_search_edit").hide();
    });
    
    $("table#datatype td").unbind("click").click(function(){
        $("table#datatype td").removeClass("selected");
        $(this).addClass("selected");
        $("input#datavalue").focus();
    });
function onClickClearResults()
    $("input#datavalue").val("");
    $("#results_count").hide();
    $("table#resultList tr").remove();
    $("table#resultList").attr("currentCount", 0);
    if(typeof h5gg!='undefined') h5gg.clearResults();
function loadResults(from, count)
    var maxCount = count;
    var skipCount = from;
    
    var results = h5gg.getResults(maxCount, skipCount);
    
    //alert("count"+count+":"+results.length+":"+results[0].address);
    
    for(var i=0; i<results.length; i++)
    {
        if(results[i].type=='F32' || results[i].type=='F64')
            results[i].value = '('+results[i].value+')';
        var row = '<tr address="'+results[i].address+'" datatype="'+results[i].type+'" datavalue="'+results[i].value+'"><td>'+(from+i+1)+'. '+results[i].address+'<br/><font>'+results[i].value+'</font></td></tr>';
        
        $("table#resultList tbody").append(row);
    }
function onClickRefreshResults(clean)
   $("table#resultList tr").remove();
   if(clean) {
       $("#listdiv").get(0).scroll(0,0);
       $("table#resultList").attr("currentCount", 0);
   }
    var count = h5gg.getResultsCount();
    $("#results_count").text("
"+count+"
    $("#results_count").show();
    
    var currentCount = Number($("table#resultList").attr("currentCount"));
    if(isNaN(currentCount) || currentCount==0) {
        currentCount = 100;
        $("table#resultList").attr("currentCount", 100);
    }
    
    loadResults(0, currentCount);
function loadMoreResults() {
    console.log("load more data!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!"+Math.random());
    
    //

    //
    $("table#resultList").attr("currentCount", currentCount+100);
    
    loadResults(currentCount, 100);

    if(lh <= div.clientHeight) {
        console.log("trigger bottom!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!");
        loadMoreResults();
    }

function h5ggType(type)
    if($("input:radio[name=numtype]:checked").val()=="unsigned") {
        switch(type) {
            case "I8":
                return "U8";
            case "I16":
                return "U16";
            case "I32":
                return "U32";
            case "I64":
                return "U64";
        }
    }
    
    return type;

                    if($("#popup_proclist").is(":visible"))
                        refreshProcList(h5gg.getProcList());
                    if($("#procname").attr('pid'))
                    {
                        var procs = h5gg.getProcList();
                        var alive = false;
                        for(var i=0; i<procs.length; i++) {
                            if(procs[i].pid == $("#procname").attr('pid')) {
                                alive=true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        
                        if(!alive) {
                            alert("Target process terminated\n\nPlease click on the title bar to select a new target");
                            $("#procname").removeAttr('pid');
                            $("#procname").text('');
                        }
                    }
                    
                }, 1500);
                
            } else  {
                $("#crossproc").hide();
            }
            
        }; //end of checkprocs
        
        checkprocs();
        //setInterval(checkprocs, 1500);
    
    } //end of h5gg check

    $("table#resultList").on('click','tr', function()
    {
        $("table#resultList tr").removeClass("hilight");
        $(this).addClass("hilight");
        
        var address = $(this).attr("address");
        var datatype = $(this).attr("datatype");
        var datavalue = $(this).attr("datavalue");
        
        //
        if(typeof h5gg!='undefined')
            datavalue = h5gg.getValue(address, h5ggType(datatype));
        
        showPopView("&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit&nbsp;&nbsp;", function(type, value){
            
            if(!h5gg.setValue(address, value, h5ggType(type))) {

            }
            
            onClickRefreshResults();

    });
function refreshProcList(procs)
    $("#proctable button").remove();
    
    for(var i=0; i<procs.length; i++) {
        var proc = procs[i];
        var btn = $("<button>"+proc.name+"</button>");
        btn.attr("pid", proc.pid);
        btn.click(function()
        {
            if(!h5gg.setTargetProc($(this).attr('pid'))) {
                alert("Cannot Select Target!");
                return;
            }
            
            onClickClearResults();
            
            $("#procname").attr('pid', $(this).attr('pid'));
            $("#procname").text($(this).text());
            $("#popup_proclist").hide();
            $("#maskview").hide();
        });
        
        $("#proctable").append(btn);
    }
function refreshLocalSrcipts()
    $("table#localjslist tr").remove();
    
    var jsfiles = h5gg.getLocalScripts();
    setTimeout(function(){
        
        if(jsfiles.length==0) {
            $("table#localjslist tbody").append("<tr><td colspan=2>Searching App's Documents Directory...<br/>Searching .app Bundle Directory...<br/>No (*.js) or (*.html) files found!</td></td>");
        }
        
        $("table#localjslist tbody").append('<tr><td style="border-right-style:none; color:blue">Browser on File App</td><td style="border-left-style:none;width:45px"><button onclick="h5gg.pickScriptFile(onClickLoadScript)">Load</button></td></tr>');
        
        for(var i=0; i<jsfiles.length; i++) {
            var row = '<tr><td style="border-right-style:none;font-weight:bold;color:green">'+jsfiles[i].name+'</td><td style="border-left-style:none;width:45px"><button onclick="onClickLoadScript(\''+jsfiles[i].path+'\')">Load</button></td></tr>';
            $("table#localjslist tbody").append(row);
        }
    }, 300);
function onShowLoadScript(show)
    if(show) {
        $("#maskview").show();
        $("#popup_loadscripts").show();
        
        if(typeof h5gg!='undefined') refreshLocalSrcipts();
    } else {
        $("#maskview").hide();
        $("#popup_loadscripts").hide();
    }
function onClickLoadScript(url, type)
    if(!url) return;
    
    if(/^\w+\:/.test(url)==false) url = "file://"+url;
    
    try{
        url = new URL(url);
        url.searchParams.append("_", Math.random());
    }catch(e){
        alert("invliad URL!");
        return;
    }
    
    $("#popup_progress").show();
    $("#maskview_script").show();
    
    if(type=='h5' || (!type&&!/\.js$/.test(url.pathname))) {
        window.location = url.href;
        return;
    }
    
    var script = document.createElement("script");
    script.type = "text/javascript";
    
    script.onload = function () {
      alert("JS Run Complete!");
        $("#popup_progress").hide();
        $("#maskview_script").hide();
    };
    
    script.onerror = function () {
        alert("Load Error!\nURL Invalid or Network Exception!");
        $("#popup_progress").hide();
        $("#maskview_script").hide();
    };
    script.src = url.href;
    document.body.appendChild(script);
function showPopView(name, action, type, value)
    $("#maskview").show();
    $("#popup_search_edit").show();
    $("#popup_search_edit").find("B#titleBar").html(name);
    $("#popup_search_edit").find("button#action").html(name);
    
    if(type) {
        $("table#datatype td").each(function(){
            if($(this).text()==type)
                $(this).addClass("selected");
            else
                $(this).removeClass("selected");
        });
    }
    
    if(value) {
        $("input#datavalue").val(value);
    }
    
    $("input#datavalue").focus();
    
    $("#popup_search_edit").find("button#action").unbind("click").click(function(){
        var type = $("table#datatype td.selected").text();
        var value = $("input#datavalue").val();
        
        $("#popup_search_edit").hide();
        $("#popup_progress").show();
        
        setTimeout(function() {
            
            action(type, value);
            
            $("#popup_progress").hide();
            $("#maskview").hide();
        }, 200);
        
    });
    
    $("#popup_search_edit").find("button#cancel").unbind("click").click(function(){
        $("#maskview").hide();
        $("#popup_search_edit").hide();
    });
    
    $("table#datatype td").unbind("click").click(function(){
        $("table#datatype td").removeClass("selected");
        $(this).addClass("selected");
        $("input#datavalue").focus();
    });
function onClickClearResults()
    $("input#datavalue").val("");
    $("#results_count").hide();
    $("table#resultList tr").remove();
    $("table#resultList").attr("currentCount", 0);
    if(typeof h5gg!='undefined') h5gg.clearResults();
function loadResults(from, count)
    var maxCount = count;
    var skipCount = from;
    
    var results = h5gg.getResults(maxCount, skipCount);
    
    //alert("count"+count+":"+results.length+":"+results[0].address);
    
    for(var i=0; i<results.length; i++)
    {
        if(results[i].type=='F32' || results[i].type=='F64')
            results[i].value = '('+results[i].value+')';
        var row = '<tr address="'+results[i].address+'" datatype="'+results[i].type+'" datavalue="'+results[i].value+'"><td>'+(from+i+1)+'. '+results[i].address+'<br/><font>'+results[i].value+'</font></td></tr>';
        
        $("table#resultList tbody").append(row);
    }
function onClickRefreshResults(clean)
   $("table#resultList tr").remove();
   if(clean) {
       $("#listdiv").get(0).scroll(0,0);
       $("table#resultList").attr("currentCount", 0);
   }
    var count = h5gg.getResultsCount();
    $("#results_count").text("Results Count: "+count);
    $("#results_count").show();
    
    var currentCount = Number($("table#resultList").attr("currentCount"));
    if(isNaN(currentCount) || currentCount==0) {
        currentCount = 100;
        $("table#resultList").attr("currentCount", 100);
    }
    
    loadResults(0, currentCount);
function loadMoreResults() {
    console.log("load more data!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!"+Math.random());
    
    //
    var currentCount = Number($("table#resultList").attr("currentCount"));
    
    //
    $("table#resultList").attr("currentCount", currentCount+100);
    
    loadResults(currentCount, 100);
function showMoreResults(div)
    var lh = div.scrollHeight - div.scrollTop;
    console.log(div.clientHeight+","+div.offsetHeight +" : " +div.scrollTop+","+div.scrollHeight + " : " + lh);
    
    if(lh <= div.clientHeight) {
        console.log("trigger bottom!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!");
        loadMoreResults();
    }

    });
